title: Working with Dates
learning_objectives: Parse ISO date strings with pd.to_datetime and an explicit format
Subtract dates to get durations in days
Compare pandas date arithmetic with the datetime module
entry_point: days_between_manual(start, end); parse_dates(df, col); add_date_parts(df, col); add_duration(df, start, end); in_month(df, col, year, month)
hints: `d = df[col].dt`; `df.assign(year=d.year, month=d.month, weekday=d.day_name())`; filter with `(d.year == year) & (d.month == month)`.

failure_feedback.advice: Convert both strings with `datetime.date.fromisoformat` and take `.days` of the difference.
Pass `format="%Y-%m-%d"` so a different format raises instead of being guessed.
Parse both columns, subtract, and use `.dt.days`.
Combine the year and month conditions with `&` and reset the index.
